questions.en:
HOTSPOT
-

You have a Microsoft 365 E5 subscription that contains a Microsoft SharePoint Online site named Site1.

In Site1, you identify the suspicious files shown in the following table.








In Microsoft Purview, you create the content searches shown in the following table.













For each of the following statements, select Yes if the statement is true. Otherwise, select No.

NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.
questions.zh:
HOTSPOT -
你有一个 Microsoft 365 E5 订阅，其中包含一个名为 Site1 的 Microsoft SharePoint Online 网站。

在 Site1 中，你识别出下表所列的可疑文件。

在 Microsoft Purview 中，你创建下表所列的内容搜索。

对于以下每条陈述，如果陈述为真，请选择“是”；否则选择“否”。

注：每个正确选择值 1 分。
questions.explanation_zh: 关键是 KQL/Purview 查询里的语法：Search1 写成 `-ItemClass=IPM.Document`，`-` 是排除（NOT）运算符，等于把 ItemClass 为 IPM.Document 的文档全部排除，所以 File1.docx 反而查不到，答 No；Search2 `filetype=doc` + `author=User2@contoso.com`，作者匹配且题库判定文件类型条件也命中 Word 文档，答 Yes；Search3 `contenttype:item document` 表示“文档类项目”，正好覆盖 docx，作者也匹配 User3，答 Yes。记规律：查询里带 `-` 前缀＝取反，别把它当成属性名的一部分。

questions.en:
You have a Microsoft 365 E5 subscription that contains a device named Device1.

From the Microsoft Defender portal, you discover that an alert was triggered for Device1.

From the Device inventory page, you isolate Device1.

You need to collect a list of installed programs on Device1.

What should you do?
questions.zh:
你有一个包含名为 Device1 的设备的 Microsoft 365 E5 订阅。

你从 Microsoft Defender 门户发现 Device1 触发了警报。

你在“设备清单”（Device inventory）页隔离了 Device1。

你需要收集 Device1 上已安装程序的列表。

你应怎么做？

options.en: Initiate a live response session and run the processes command.
options.zh: 启动实时响应会话并运行 processes 命令。

options.en: Initiate an automated investigation and view the results in the Action center.
options.zh: 启动自动调查，并在操作中心查看结果。

options.en: Initiate a live response session and run the analyze command.
options.zh: 启动实时响应会话并运行 analyze 命令。

options.en: Run an advanced hunting query against the DeviceTvmSoftwareInventory table.
options.zh: 对 DeviceTvmSoftwareInventory 表运行高级搜寻查询。

questions.explanation_zh: 已安装程序清单由 Defender 漏洞管理写入 TvmSoftwareInventory 表，用高级搜寻按设备过滤该表即可得到软件名称与版本。DeviceProcessEvents 只有进程事件，自动调查结果和 live response 的进程命令都无法完整反映已安装程序。

questions.en:
You have two Microsoft Entra tenants named Tenant1 and Tenant2. Each tenant is linked to an Azure subscription.
Tenant1 contains a group named Group1. Tenant2 contains a group named Group2.

You need to implement Microsoft Sentinel for each tenant. The solution must meet the following requirements:

• Ensure that Group1 can manage security incidents for Tenant1 and Tenant2 in a single workspace.
• Ensure that Group2 can manage security incidents only for Tenant2.
• Minimize the use of guest accounts.
• Minimize administrative effort.
• Minimize costs.

What should you include in the solution?
questions.zh:
你有两个分别名为 Tenant1 和 Tenant2 的 Microsoft Entra 租户。每个租户都链接到一个 Azure 订阅。Tenant1 包含名为 Group1 的组。Tenant2 包含名为 Group2 的组。

你需要为每个租户实施 Microsoft Sentinel。解决方案必须满足以下要求：

• 确保 Group1 可以在单个工作区中管理 Tenant1 和 Tenant2 的安全事件。
• 确保 Group2 只能管理 Tenant2 的安全事件。
• 尽量减少来宾账户（guest account）的使用。
• 尽量减少管理工作量。
• 尽量减少成本。

解决方案中应包含什么？

options.en: one workspace and Privileged Identity Management (PIM)
options.zh: 一个工作区加 Privileged Identity Management（PIM）

options.en: one workspace and multiple role-based access control (RBAC) role assignments
options.zh: 一个工作区加多个基于角色的访问控制（RBAC）角色分配
两个工作区加 Azure Lighthouse

options.en: two workspaces and granular delegated admin privileges (GDAP)
options.zh: 两个工作区加精细委派管理员权限（GDAP）

questions.explanation_zh: 跨租户场景应使用 Azure Lighthouse 委派管理，把 Tenant2 的工作区授权给 Tenant1 的 Group1，无需创建来宾账户；Group2 只在 Tenant2 的工作区获得角色。两个租户各保留一个工作区可实现数据与权限隔离，同时满足最小权限、最小管理成本与低成本要求。

你应如何补全该 KQL 查询？要回答，请在答案区域选择相应的选项。

slots.zh: 空 2 · 交给 split 处理的字段

questions.explanation_zh: 先用 RequestUri has_all 过滤 /directoryRoles/ 与 members/$ref 且 RequestMethod 为 POST 的请求，再用 ResponseStatusCode in ("204") 只保留成功的写操作，最后以 split(RequestUri, "/")[-3] 从请求 URI 提取被改动的角色 ID，故第二个空填 RequestUri。

questions.en:
HOTSPOT
-

You have a Microsoft 365 subscription that uses Microsoft Defender for Endpoint and contains the following devices:

• Device1: Runs Windows 11 Pro
• Device2: Runs Windows Server
• Device3: Runs Ubuntu Linux

You identify three suspicious files named File1.exe, File2.zip, and File3.ps1.

You need to investigate the files by using deep analysis.

Which devices support deep analysis, and which files can be submitted for deep analysis? To answer, select the
appropriate options in the answer area.

NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.
questions.zh:
HOTSPOT -
你有一个使用 Microsoft Defender for Endpoint 的 Microsoft 365 订阅，其中包含以下设备：

• Device1：运行 Windows 11 Pro
• Device2：运行 Windows Server
• Device3：运行 Ubuntu Linux

你识别出三个可疑文件，分别名为 File1.exe、File2.zip 和 File3.ps1。

你需要使用深度分析（deep analysis）调查这些文件。

哪些设备支持深度分析？哪些文件可以提交深度分析？要回答，请在答案区域选择相应的选项。

注：每个正确选择值 1 分。
questions.explanation_zh: 深度分析支持提交可执行文件、压缩包与脚本等类型的文件，三个可疑文件都可在设备时间线中提交。提交来源也不受平台限制，Windows 11、Windows Server 与 Ubuntu Linux 三台已载入设备均可发起深度分析，因此文件和设备均全选。

questions.en:
You have a Microsoft 365 subscription. The subscription contains 500 Windows 11 devices that are onboarded to
Microsoft Defender for Endpoint.

You have 500 devices that run Linux.

Users sign in to the Windows and Linux devices by using their Microsoft Entra credentials.

You need to recommend a response process for Microsoft Defender XDR security incidents associated with a
compromised Linux endpoint. The solution must ensure that the compromised device is prevented from communicating
with all devices onboarded to Defender for Endpoint.

Which response action should you include in the recommendation?
questions.zh:
你有一个 Microsoft 365 订阅。该订阅包含 500 台已载入 Microsoft Defender for Endpoint 的 Windows 11 设备。

你有 500 台运行 Linux 的设备。

用户使用其 Microsoft Entra 凭据登录 Windows 和 Linux 设备。

你需要为与受入侵 Linux 终结点相关的 Microsoft Defender XDR 安全事件推荐一个响应流程。解决方案必须确保阻止该受入侵设备与所有已载入 Defender for Endpoint 的设备通信。

你应在建议中包含哪个响应操作？

options.zh: 确认用户受入侵（Confirm user compromised）

questions.explanation_zh: 题目要求让失陷的 Linux 终端“无法与所有已载入 Defender for Endpoint 的设备通信”，隔离设备（Isolate device）会切断该设备除 Defender for Endpoint 云服务通道外的一切网络通信，正好满足，且 Linux 终端支持该操作，因此按题库选 C。注意这题争议很大：社区投票 100% 选了 B（Contain device）。区分点在于“包含设备”是按允许清单放行的部分限制，被放行的应用仍可通信，不保证与所有已载入设备完全断开；隔离则是彻底断网只留 EDR 通道。考试按题库选 Isolate device。

You have an Azure subscription that contains a user named User1 and a Microsoft Sentinel workspace named WS1.

You deploy Advanced Security Information Model (ASIM) authentication parsers to WS1.

You need to use the parsers to query the authentication events generated by User1 during the last 24 hours. The solution
must maximize the performance of the query.

How should you complete the query? To answer, select the appropriate options in the answer area.

NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.
questions.zh:
HOTSPOT -
你有一个 Azure 订阅，其中包含一个名为 User1 的用户和一个名为 WS1 的 Microsoft Sentinel 工作区。

你向 WS1 部署高级安全信息模型（ASIM）身份验证解析器。

你需要使用这些解析器查询 User1 在过去 24 小时内生成的身份验证事件。解决方案必须最大限度地提升查询性能。

你应如何补全该查询？要回答，请在答案区域选择相应的选项。

注：每个正确选择值 1 分。
questions.explanation_zh: 使用 ASIM 时应调用统一规范化入口 ASimAuthentication(...)，它会按来源自动选择认证解析器并输出规范化字段。解析器输出的是标准字段 TargetUsername，因此高效过滤要用 targetusername_has（等价于对 TargetUsername 做 has 匹配），而不是对原始字段用 contains。

questions.zh:
HOTSPOT -
你有一个 Azure 订阅，其中包含一个名为 User1 的用户和一个名为 WS1 的 Microsoft Sentinel 工作区。

你需要确保 User1 可以为 WS1 启用用户和实体行为分析（UEBA）。解决方案必须遵循最小权限原则。

你应为 User1 分配哪些角色？要回答，请在答案区域选择相应的选项。

注：每个正确选择值 1 分。

options.zh: Microsoft Sentinel 自动化参与者

questions.explanation_zh: 启用 UEBA 需要同时具备 Entra 目录侧的读取/安全设置权限和工作区侧的写入权限：目录侧最小可用角色是 Security Administrator（Global Administrator 权限过大），工作区侧需要 Microsoft Sentinel Contributor 才能开启 UEBA 并配置数据源；Automation Contributor 只用于运行 Playbook。

questions.en:
DRAG DROP
-

You have a Microsoft Sentinel workspace named SW1.

In SW1, you enable User and Entity Behavior Analytics (UEBA).

You need to use KQL to perform the following tasks:

• View the entity data that has fields for each type of entity.
• Assess the quality of rules by analyzing how well a rule performs.

Which table should you use in KQL for each task? To answer, drag the appropriate tables to the correct tasks. Each
table may be used once, more than once, or not at all. You may need to drag the split bar between panes or scroll to
view content.

NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.
questions.zh:
拖放（DRAG DROP）

你有一个名为 SW1 的 Microsoft Sentinel 工作区。

在 SW1 中，你启用用户和实体行为分析（UEBA）。

你需要使用 KQL 执行以下任务：

• 查看包含各类实体字段的实体数据。
• 通过分析规则的执行效果来评估规则质量。

每个任务应在 KQL 中使用哪个表？要回答，请将相应的表拖到正确的任务上。每个表可以使用一次、多次，或不使用。你可能需要拖动窗格之间的分隔条或滚动以查看内容。

注：每个正确选择值 1 分。
questions.explanation_zh: BehaviorAnalytics 表按实体类型提供标准化字段（用户、主机、IP 地址等），用于查看各类实体的行为数据；Anomalies 表记录 UEBA 生成的异常及其评分与说明，可用于评估规则和异常检测的质量。AuditLogs、AzureDiagnostics、CommonSecurityLog 与该用途无关。

questions.en:
Your on-premises network contains an Active Directory Domain Services (AD DS) forest.

You have a Microsoft Entra tenant that uses Microsoft Defender for Identity. The AD DS forest syncs with the tenant.

You need to create a hunting query that will identify LDAP simple binds to the AD DS domain controllers.

Which table should you query?
questions.zh:
你的本地网络包含一个 Active Directory 域服务（AD DS）林。

你有一个使用 Microsoft Defender for Identity 的 Microsoft Entra 租户。该 AD DS 林与该租户同步。

你需要创建一条搜寻查询，用于识别发往 AD DS 域控制器的 LDAP 简单绑定（simple bind）。

你应查询哪个表？
questions.explanation_zh: Defender for Identity 采集的登录类事件（含针对域控的 LDAP 简单绑定）进入高级搜寻的 IdentityLogonEvents 表。AADServicePrincipalRiskEvents 是服务主体风险，AADDomainServicesAccountLogon 与 SigninLogs 分别是域服务账户登录和 Entra 用户登录，均不含 LDAP 绑定。

questions.en:
HOTSPOT
-

You have a Microsoft 365 subscription.

You need to identify all the security principals that submitted requests to change or delete groups.

How should you complete the KQL query? To answer, select the appropriate options in the answer area.

NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.
questions.zh:
HOTSPOT -
你有一个 Microsoft 365 订阅。

你需要识别所有提交了更改或删除组请求的安全主体。

你应如何补全该 KQL 查询？要回答，请在答案区域选择相应的选项。

注：每个正确选择值 1 分。

slots.zh: 空 1 · 包含 '/group' 的字段

questions.explanation_zh: 要识别更改或删除组的请求，需按请求地址过滤，故第一个空用 RequestUri contains '/group'；再排除读取类的 GET 请求（RequestMethod != "GET"），剩下的 POST、PUT、PATCH、DELETE 才是变更操作，最后投影 AppId、UserId、ServicePrincipalId 即可得到提交请求的安全主体。

questions.en:
You have a Microsoft 365 subscription that uses Microsoft Defender for Endpoint Plan 2 and contains a macOS device
named Device1.

You need to investigate a Defender for Endpoint agent alert on Device1. The solution must meet the following
requirements:

• Identify all the active network connections on Device1.
• Identify all the running processes on Device1.
• Retrieve the login history of Device1.
• Minimize administrative effort.

What should you do first from the Microsoft Defender portal?
questions.zh:
你有一个使用 Microsoft Defender for Endpoint 计划 2 并包含名为 Device1 的 macOS 设备的 Microsoft 365 订阅。

你需要调查 Device1 上的一起 Defender for Endpoint 代理警报。解决方案必须满足以下要求：

• 识别 Device1 上的所有活动网络连接。
• 识别 Device1 上所有正在运行的进程。
• 获取 Device1 的登录历史。
• 尽量减少管理工作量。

你应首先从 Microsoft Defender 门户做什么？

options.en: From Devices, click Collect investigation package for Device1.
options.zh: 在“设备”中为 Device1 单击“收集调查包”。

options.en: From Advanced features in Endpoints, enable Live Response unsigned script execution.
options.zh: 在终结点（Endpoints）的“高级功能”中启用实时响应未签名脚本执行（Live Response unsigned script execution）。

options.en: From Devices, initiate a live response session on Device1.
options.zh: 在“设备”中为 Device1 启动实时响应会话。

options.en: From Advanced features in Endpoints, disable Authenticated telemetry.
options.zh: 在终结点（Endpoints）的“高级功能”中禁用经身份验证的遥测（Authenticated telemetry）。

questions.explanation_zh: 题目要同时拿到活动网络连接、运行进程和登录历史，还要最省事：直接对 Device1 收集调查包（investigation package），Defender 会在设备上自动采集进程、网络连接、登录/用户等取证数据并打包，下载解压即得，不必逐条敲命令。选项 B、D 都只是实时响应/终结点的高级功能开关，本身不产出数据；实时响应会话（选项 C）适合交互式排查，但要自己一条条命令查，管理开销高于收集调查包。题库答案 A（社区 72% 认同）。

questions.en:
HOTSPOT
-

You have a Microsoft Sentinel workspace.

You plan to visualize data from Microsoft SharePoint Online and OneDrive sites.

You need to create a KQL query for the visual. The solution must meet the following requirements:

• Select all workloads as a single operation.
• Include two parameters named Operations and Users.
• In the results, exclude empty values for the site URLs.

How should you complete the query? To answer, select the appropriate options in the answer area.

NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.
questions.zh:
HOTSPOT -
你有一个 Microsoft Sentinel 工作区。

你计划可视化 Microsoft SharePoint Online 和 OneDrive 网站的数据。

你需要为该可视化创建 KQL 查询。解决方案必须满足以下要求：

• 通过一次操作选择所有工作负载。
• 包含两个名为 Operations 和 Users 的参数。
• 在结果中排除站点 URL 的空值。

你应如何补全该查询？要回答，请在答案区域选择相应的选项。

注：每个正确选择值 1 分。
questions.explanation_zh: 工作簿/KQL 里参数一律用花括号引用：`where Operation in ({Operations})` 把“所有工作负载”一次性纳入筛选，写成双括号 `((Operations))` 或 `"{Operations}"` 都不对。第二空的考点在列名：OfficeActivity 里站点 URL 的列是 `Site_Url`（带下划线），选项里 `where SiteUrl != ""` 用的是不存在的列名（少了下划线），在 KQL 里引用未知列会直接报错，所以只能选能成立的 `project Site_Url`。题干说的“排除空站点 URL”在这个选项集里并没有正确的实现项，别被它带偏。

questions.en:
HOTSPOT
-

You have a Microsoft Sentinel workspace that contains a custom workbook.

You need to query for a summary of security events. The solution must meet the following requirements:

• Identify the number of security events ingested during the past week.
• Display the count of events by day in a chart.

How should you complete the query? To answer, select the appropriate options in the answer area.

NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.
questions.zh:
HOTSPOT -
你有一个 Microsoft Sentinel 工作区，其中包含一个自定义工作簿。

你需要查询安全事件摘要。解决方案必须满足以下要求：

• 确定过去一周内引入的安全事件数量。
• 在图表中按天显示事件计数。

你应如何补全该查询？要回答，请在答案区域选择相应的选项。

注：每个正确选择值 1 分。
questions.explanation_zh: 统计一周内每天的安全事件数需要按时间分桶，用 bin 把 TimeGenerated 划分为固定间隔的时间段，再 summarize count() 聚合后 render timechart 画出按天图表。coalesce、extract、max_of 不是时间分桶函数，Account、EventID、ProcessId 也不是时间字段。

questions.en:
HOTSPOT
-

You have a Microsoft Sentinel workspace that contains a custom workbook named Workbook1.

You need to create a visual in Workbook1 that will display the logon count for accounts that have logon event IDs of 4624
and 4634.

How should you complete the query? To answer, select the appropriate options in the answer area.

NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.
questions.zh:
HOTSPOT -
你有一个 Microsoft Sentinel 工作区，其中包含一个名为 Workbook1 的自定义工作簿。

你需要在 Workbook1 中创建一个可视化，用于显示登录事件 ID 为 4624 和 4634 的账户的登录次数。

你应如何补全该查询？要回答，请在答案区域选择相应的选项。

注：每个正确选择值 1 分。
questions.explanation_zh: 要把 4624（登录）与 4634（注销）两次 summarize 的结果按 Account 关联，应使用 join 运算符；kind=inner 只保留两个结果集中都存在的账户，使登录数与注销数一一对应。union 是纵向合并，full/left/right 会产生缺少对应事件的行。

questions.en:
You have 500 on-premises Windows 11 devices that use Microsoft Defender for Endpoint.
You enable Network device discovery.

You need to create a hunting query that will identify discovered network devices and return the identity of the onboarded
device that discovered each network device.

Which built-in function should you use?
questions.zh:
你有 500 台使用 Microsoft Defender for Endpoint 的本地 Windows 11 设备。
你启用网络设备发现（Network device discovery）。

你需要创建一条搜寻查询，用于识别已发现的网络设备，并返回发现每个网络设备的已载入设备的标识。

你应使用哪个内置函数？
questions.explanation_zh: Defender for Endpoint 提供 SeenBy() 函数，可返回发现某个网络设备的已载入设备信息（设备名、设备 ID 等），网络设备发现场景正是用它把网络设备与发现者关联。DeviceFromIP() 是按 IP 反查设备，next()、current_cluster_endpoint() 与设备发现结果无关。

questions.en:
You have an Azure subscription that contains a resource group named RG1. RG1 contains a Microsoft Sentinel
workspace. The subscription is linked to a Microsoft Entra tenant that contains a user named User1.

You need to ensure that User1 can deploy and customize Microsoft Sentinel workbook templates. The solution must
follow the principle of least privilege.

Which role should you assign to User1 for RG1?
questions.zh:
你有一个包含名为 RG1 的资源组的 Azure 订阅。RG1 包含一个 Microsoft Sentinel 工作区。该订阅链接到一个包含名为 User1 的用户的 Microsoft Entra 租户。

你需要确保 User1 可以部署和自定义 Microsoft Sentinel 工作簿模板。解决方案必须遵循最小权限原则。

你应为 User1 在 RG1 上分配哪个角色？

options.zh: Microsoft Sentinel Contributor（Microsoft Sentinel 参与者）
Microsoft Sentinel Automation Contributor（Microsoft Sentinel 自动化参与者）

questions.explanation_zh: Microsoft Sentinel 工作簿保存在工作区中，部署和自定义模板只需对该工作簿具备写权限。工作簿撰稿人角色仅在 Sentinel 工作簿范围内授予创建、编辑、删除和共享权限，符合最低特权原则；而 Microsoft Sentinel 参与者与贡献者会一并带来分析规则、数据连接器、自动化等更广的管理权限，明显超出本题需要。

questions.en:
HOTSPOT
-

You have a Microsoft 365 subscription that uses Microsoft Defender XDR.

You need to create a custom detection rule that will identify devices that had more than five antivirus detections within the
last 24 hours.

How should you complete the query? To answer, select the appropriate options in the answer area.

NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.
questions.zh:
HOTSPOT -
你有一个使用 Microsoft Defender XDR 的 Microsoft 365 订阅。

你需要创建一条自定义检测规则，用于识别过去 24 小时内防病毒检测次数超过五次的设备。

你应如何补全该查询？要回答，请在答案区域选择相应的选项。

注：每个正确选择值 1 分。

slots.en: Field returned by arg_max and renamed Timestamp
slots.zh: 空 1 · 由 arg_max 返回并重命名为 Timestamp 的字段

slots.en: Field used to determine the latest record
slots.zh: 空 2 · 用于取最新记录的字段

questions.explanation_zh: 查询骨架是 `summarize (Timestamp, <别名>) = arg_max(Timestamp, <返回列>), count() by DeviceId`：arg_max 的第一个参数是“按哪列取最大值”（Timestamp），第二个参数是“返回哪一列的值”。要让每条结果带住那一次最新检测的标识，返回列只能选 ReportId（把 DeviceId 返回会和 by DeviceId 重复，TimeGenerated 列在 DeviceEvents 里不存在），第一个空是给返回列起的名字，与 ReportId 保持一致即可。自定义检测规则要求结果集里必须有 Timestamp 列，用 arg_max 取最新一条才能保证时间与检测记录对齐。

questions.en:
HOTSPOT
-

You need to build a KQL query in a Microsoft Sentinel workspace. The query must return the SecurityEvent record for
accounts that have the last record with an EventID value of 4624.

How should you complete the query? To answer, select the appropriate options in the answer area.

NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.
questions.zh:
HOTSPOT -
你需要在 Microsoft Sentinel 工作区中构建一个 KQL 查询。该查询必须返回 EventID 值为 4624 的账户的最后一条 SecurityEvent 记录。

你应如何补全该查询？要回答，请在答案区域选择相应的选项。

注：每个正确选择值 1 分。

slots.zh: 空 1 · 筛选登录事件的行

slots.en: Line that returns the last record for each account
slots.zh: 空 2 · 返回每个账户最后一条记录的行

questions.explanation_zh: 题目要每个账户“最后一条且 EventID 为 4624”的记录，因此必须先用 where 过滤出 4624 的登录成功事件，再按 Account 用 arg_max(TimeGenerated, *) 取整行最新记录。若先 summarize 再过滤，取到的是账户最近一条任意事件，最新记录不是 4624 的账户会被错误丢弃；make_set、make_list 只生成数组，无法返回单条完整记录。

questions.en:
You have a Microsoft 365 subscription that contains a user named User1 and two Windows devices named Device1
and Device2. Device1 and Device2 are onboarded to Microsoft Defender for Endpoint.

The following events occur.

• User1 signs in to Device1.
• Automatic attack disruption in Microsoft Defender XDR responds to an attack on Device1 and contains User1.
• User1 attempts to connect to Device2.

Which protocols will Device2 block when User1 attempts to connect to Device2?
questions.zh:
你有一个包含名为 User1 的用户以及名为 Device1 和 Device2 的两台 Windows 设备的 Microsoft 365 订阅。Device1 和 Device2 已载入 Microsoft Defender for Endpoint。

发生以下事件。

• User1 登录 Device1。
• Microsoft Defender XDR 中的自动攻击中断响应 Device1 上的一次攻击，并遏制了 User1。
• User1 尝试连接 Device2。

当 User1 尝试连接 Device2 时，Device2 会阻止哪些协议？
questions.explanation_zh: 自动攻击中断在遏制受攻击设备时会同时对相关用户执行“用户遏制”，即在其他已载入的终结点上阻断该用户发起的远程连接。Defender for Endpoint 的用户遏制只拦截 RDP、RPC 和 SMB 三类协议，不会阻断 HTTP、Kerberos 等其余流量，因此只有同时含三项的选项才完整，只列一项或两项都会漏掉部分协议。

questions.en:
You have an Azure subscription that contains a Microsoft Sentinel workspace named WS1. WS1 has the Azure Activity
connector and the Microsoft Entra ID connector configured.

You need to investigate which accounts have the most alerts and any corresponding incident information for each alert.
The solution must minimize administrative effort.

What should you do first in WS1?
questions.zh:
你有一个包含名为 WS1 的 Microsoft Sentinel 工作区的 Azure 订阅。WS1 已配置 Azure 活动连接器和 Microsoft Entra ID 连接器。

你需要调查哪些账户的警报最多，以及每条警报对应的事件信息。解决方案必须尽量减少管理工作量。

你应首先在 WS1 中做什么？

options.en: Use User and Entity Behavior Analytics (UEBA) to detect anomalies.
options.zh: 使用用户和实体行为分析（UEBA）检测异常。

options.en: Enable User and Entity Behavior Analytics (UEBA).
options.zh: 启用用户和实体行为分析（UEBA）。

options.en: From Content hub, install the Microsoft Purview insider risk management solution.
options.zh: 从内容中心安装 Microsoft Purview 内部风险管理（insider risk management）解决方案。

options.en: From Content hub, install Cloud Identity Threat Protection Essentials.
options.zh: 从内容中心安装 Cloud Identity Threat Protection Essentials。

questions.explanation_zh: 要按账户查看“警报最多”并关联事件中的实体信息，依赖 UEBA 提供的实体页面与行为洞察。UEBA 在 Sentinel 中必须先启用，否则实体页只能显示原始日志；仅配置 Azure Activity 与 Microsoft Entra ID 连接器只是把日志接入。选项 A 是启用之后的使用动作，C、D 与警报的账户实体分析无关。

questions.en:
You have a Microsoft 365 E5 subscription that uses Microsoft Copilot for Security.

You plan to run the following code to create a custom Copilot for Security plugin.








You need to specify a format and complete the code segment.

Which format should you use for the                  variable?
questions.zh:
你有一个使用 Microsoft Copilot for Security 的 Microsoft 365 E5 订阅。

你计划运行以下代码来创建自定义 Copilot for Security 插件。








你需要指定一种格式并补全该代码段。

你应为 ________ 变量使用哪种格式？
questions.explanation_zh: Security Copilot 自定义插件在定义技能和变量时必须声明数据格式，调用 Defender、Sentinel 等安全数据源的技能以 KQL 查询作为格式，因此变量应设为 KQL 语句。“常规”仅用于纯文本处理，IMDb、SQL 组合键不是 Copilot 插件支持的格式，无法执行安全数据查询。

questions.en:
You have a Microsoft 365 E5 subscription that uses Microsoft Defender XDR.

You are investigating an incident.

You need to review the incident tasks that were performed.

What can you use on the Incident page?
questions.zh:
你有一个使用 Microsoft Defender XDR 的 Microsoft 365 E5 订阅。

你正在调查一起事件。

你需要查看已执行的事件任务。

在事件页面上你可以使用什么？

options.zh: 仅任务和活动日志（Activity log）
仅任务和警报时间线（Alert timeline）

options.en: Tasks, Activity log, and Alert timeline
options.zh: 任务、活动日志和警报时间线

questions.explanation_zh: Defender XDR 事件页面的“任务”卡片记录分析员执行的响应动作，活动日志记录谁在何时对事件做了哪些修改，警报时间表则呈现相关警报的发生顺序，三者结合才能完整复核已执行的操作。只选任务看不到操作审核，选项 C 缺少活动日志因而也不完整。

questions.en:
HOTSPOT
-

You have an Azure subscription.

You have a Microsoft Sentinel workbook that contains the following text parameters:

• text1
• grouptime1

You need to display the count of security alerts. The count must be filtered based on the text1 parameter and grouped by
the grouptime1 parameter.

How should you complete the KOL query? To answer, select the appropriate options in the answer area.

NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.
questions.zh:
HOTSPOT -
你有一个 Azure 订阅。

你有一个 Microsoft Sentinel 工作簿，其中包含以下文本参数：

• text1
• grouptime1

你需要显示安全警报的计数。该计数必须按 text1 参数进行筛选，并按 grouptime1 参数分组。

你应如何补全该 KQL 查询？要回答，请在答案区域选择相应的选项。

注：每个正确选择值 1 分。

slots.zh: 空 1 · text1 参数的引用写法
空 2 · grouptime1 参数的引用写法

questions.explanation_zh: 工作簿参数在 KQL 中以花括号占位符引用，运行时由工作簿引擎替换为实际参数值。写成 <text1> 或加引号的 "{text1}" 都不会生效：尖括号不是工作簿语法，加引号后占位符会被当作普通字符串常量，过滤不到数据。分组时间参数同理只能写 {grouptime1}，直接作为 bin() 的时间跨度。

questions.en:
HOTSPOT
-

You have a Microsoft 365 subscription that contains a Windows device named Device1. Device1 is onboarded to
Microsoft Defender for Endpoint.

You initiate a live response session on Device1.

You need to execute a long running script. The solution must ensure that you can run additional commands during the
session while the script is running.

How should you complete the live response command? To answer, select the appropriate options in the answer area.

NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.
questions.zh:
HOTSPOT -
你有一个 Microsoft 365 订阅，其中包含一台名为 Device1 的 Windows 设备。Device1 已载入 Microsoft Defender for Endpoint。

你在 Device1 上启动实时响应会话。

你需要执行一个长时间运行的脚本。解决方案必须确保在脚本运行期间你仍可在该会话中运行其他命令。

你应如何补全该实时响应命令？要回答，请在答案区域选择相应的选项。

注：每个正确选择值 1 分。
questions.explanation_zh: 实时响应里要把“库（live response library）中的脚本”下发并在设备上执行用 `library script1.ps1`，命令末尾加 `&` 表示放到后台异步跑，会话会立刻返回提示符，于是可以在脚本运行期间继续下别的命令（后台作业可用 `jobs` 查看、`fg` 取回前台）。其余选项：`fg` 是把后台作业拉回前台，`isolate` 是网络隔离，`run` 是前台执行会占住会话；运算符里 `$`、`|`、`!` 都不是实时响应的后台符号。

questions.en:
HOTSPOT
-

You have a Microsoft 365 E5 subscription that uses Microsoft Exchange Online.

You identify the suspicious emails shown in the following table.












In Microsoft Purview, you create the content searches shown in the following table.












For each of the following statements, select Yes if the statement is true. Otherwise, select No.

NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.
questions.zh:
HOTSPOT -
你有一个使用 Microsoft Exchange Online 的 Microsoft 365 E5 订阅。

你识别出下表所列的可疑电子邮件。

在 Microsoft Purview 中，你创建下表所列的内容搜索。

对于以下每条陈述，如果陈述为真，请选择“是”；否则选择“否”。

注：每个正确选择值 1 分。
questions.explanation_zh: 题库三句都判 Yes。三条查询里真正生效的条件分别是：Search1 的 `filetype=docx` + 发件人 prizes@contoso.com（Email1 带 File1.docx），Search2 的 `from=hrhr@contoso.com`（Email2 正是这个发件人），Search3 的 `from=benefits@contoso.com`（Email3 正是这个发件人）。本题最大的坑在 Search2 的 `-subjecttitle=benefits`：按“负号＝排除”的字面理解，Email2 主题里含 benefits 应当被排除、该判 No，但题库判 Yes——说明这里把 `subjecttitle` 当成对 Exchange 邮箱查询不生效的属性（Exchange 侧主题属性是 `Subject`），负号没排除到任何邮件。考试按题库选 Yes；同时记住真正用于邮件主题的属性名是 `Subject`，写 `subjecttitle` 时要想清楚作用域。

questions.en:
You have a Microsoft 365 E5 subscription that uses Microsoft Copilot for Security.

You have a Copilot for Security workspace that uses the following plugins:

• Microsoft Entra
• Microsoft Defender XDR

From the Microsoft Defender portal, you use Copilot for Security to investigate a reported incident.

You need to run a promptbook that will include information from Microsoft Entra ID Protection in the investigation.

What should you do first?
questions.zh:
你有一个使用 Microsoft Copilot for Security 的 Microsoft 365 E5 订阅。

你有一个使用以下插件的 Copilot for Security 工作区：

• Microsoft Entra
• Microsoft Defender XDR

你从 Microsoft Defender 门户使用 Copilot for Security 调查一起已报告的事件。

你需要运行一个提示簿（promptbook），使其调查中包含来自 Microsoft Entra ID Protection 的信息。

你应首先做什么？

options.en: From the Microsoft Defender portal, create an incident report.
options.zh: 从 Microsoft Defender 门户创建事件报告。

options.en: Open the investigation in the Copilot for Security standalone experience.
options.zh: 在 Copilot for Security 独立体验（standalone experience）中打开该调查。

options.en: Open the investigation in Microsoft Sentinel.
options.zh: 在 Microsoft Sentinel 中打开该调查。

options.en: From the Microsoft Defender portal, create an advanced hunting query.
options.zh: 从 Microsoft Defender 门户创建高级搜寻查询。

questions.explanation_zh: Defender 门户内嵌的 Copilot 只加载 Defender XDR 插件，工作区启用的 Entra 插件在嵌入体验中不可用。要让提示本引入 Entra ID Protection 数据，须先在独立体验中开启调查，再回到事件跟进；创建事件报告、高级搜寻或 Sentinel 调查都不会加载该插件。

questions.en:
You have a Microsoft 365 E5 subscription that uses Microsoft Copilot for Security.

You start a Copilot for Security session and enter five prompts that each provide responses.

You need to create a promptbook that will use the prompts but will NOT contain the responses. The solution must
minimize administrative effort.

What should you do?
questions.zh:
你有一个使用 Microsoft Copilot for Security 的 Microsoft 365 E5 订阅。

你启动一个 Copilot for Security 会话，并输入五个各自返回响应的提示。

你需要创建一个提示簿（promptbook），其中包含这些提示但不包含响应。解决方案必须尽量减少管理工作量。

你应怎么做？

options.en: Select each prompt, and then select Create promptbook.
options.zh: 逐个选择每个提示，然后选择“创建提示簿”。

options.en: Create a new promptbook and include each prompt.
options.zh: 新建一个提示簿，并逐个包含这些提示。

options.en: Enter a new prompt that has the following input: Create a promptbook from my session prompts.
options.zh: 输入一个新提示，内容为：根据我会话中的提示创建一个提示簿（Create a promptbook from my session prompts）。

options.en: Share the session, and then select Create promptbook.
options.zh: 共享该会话，然后选择“创建提示簿”。

questions.explanation_zh: 会话中可勾选若干条提示后选择“创建提示本”，生成结果只保留提示文本而不携带各自的回复，并自动带入原有顺序，管理开销最小。新建提示本再逐条录入提示容易出错且耗时；共享会话会把提示与回复一起共享，C 的“从我的会话提示创建”也不能保证剔除响应内容。

questions.en:
You have 1,000 on-premises Windows 11 Pro devices that are onboarded to Microsoft Defender for Endpoint.

You have a Microsoft 365 subscription that uses Microsoft Defender XDR.

You identify that an attacker performed the following actions on a device:

• Modified the filesystem path of a registry-based antivirus exclusion
• Downloaded a malicious file to the file system path

You initiate a live response session on the device.

You need to undo the registry change.

Which command should you run?
questions.zh:
你有 1,000 台已载入 Microsoft Defender for Endpoint 的本地 Windows 11 专业版设备。

你有一个使用 Microsoft Defender XDR 的 Microsoft 365 订阅。

你发现攻击者在一台设备上执行了以下操作：

• 修改了基于注册表的防病毒排除项的文件系统路径
• 将恶意文件下载到该文件系统路径

你在该设备上启动实时响应会话。

你需要撤销该注册表更改。

你应运行哪个命令？
questions.explanation_zh: 四个命令里只有 remediate（修正）具备“修复/回滚”能力，对检测到的实体执行修正动作，本题按题库选它移除攻击者改动的注册表型防病毒排除路径（社区 83% 认同）。registry 只是读取/浏览注册表键值的命令，scan 只触发一次扫描，analyze 只对实体做分析取证，都不会撤销注册表改动。实务警报：live response 真正改注册表值要自己 run 一条 reg 命令；本题选项里没有 run，按题库口径记 remediate 为“修正”类命令即可。

questions.en:
Your on-premises network contains two Active Directory Domain Services (AD DS) domains named contoso.com and
fabrikam.com. Contoso.com contains a group named Group1. Fabrikam.com contains a group named Group2.

You have a Microsoft Sentinel workspace named WS1 that contains a scheduled query rule named Rule1. Rule1
generates alerts in response to anomalous AD DS security events. Each alert creates an incident.

You need to implement an incident triage solution that meets the following requirements:

• Security incidents from contoso.com must be assigned to Group1.
• Security incidents from fabrikam.com must be assigned to Group2.
• Administrative effort must be minimized.

What should you include in the solution?
questions.zh:
你的本地网络包含两个分别名为 contoso.com 和 fabrikam.com 的 Active Directory 域服务（AD DS）域。contoso.com 包含名为 Group1 的组。fabrikam.com 包含名为 Group2 的组。

你有一个名为 WS1 的 Microsoft Sentinel 工作区，其中包含名为 Rule1 的计划查询规则。Rule1 针对异常的 AD DS 安全事件生成警报。每条警报都会创建一个事件。

你需要实施一个事件分类（triage）解决方案，满足以下要求：

• 来自 contoso.com 的安全事件必须分配给 Group1。
• 来自 fabrikam.com 的安全事件必须分配给 Group2。
• 必须尽量减少管理工作量。

解决方案中应包含什么？

options.en: a playbook that is triggered by the creation of an incident
options.zh: 由事件创建触发的 playbook

options.en: a playbook that is triggered by the creation of an alert
options.zh: 由警报创建触发的 playbook

options.en: one automation rule assigned to Rule1
options.zh: 分配给 Rule1 的一条自动化规则

options.en: two automation rules assigned to Rule1
options.zh: 分配给 Rule1 的两条自动化规则

questions.explanation_zh: 自动化规则可按分析规则名称、事件标题或实体等条件触发动作，但一条规则只能指定一个所有者组，所以要分别针对 contoso.com 与 fabrikam.com 创建两条规则并各自指派给 Group1、Group2。Playbook 虽也能分配，却需额外编排逻辑应用并调用 API，管理开销更大；仅一条规则无法区分两个域的事件。

questions.en:
You have a Microsoft 365 subscription.

You have the following KQL query.





You need to ensure that you can create a Microsoft Defender XDR custom detection rule by using the query.

What should you add to the query?
questions.zh:
你有一个 Microsoft 365 订阅。

你有以下 KQL 查询。






你需要确保可以使用该查询创建一条 Microsoft Defender XDR 自定义检测规则。

你应向该查询中添加什么？

options.en: | summarize (Timestamp, ReportId)=arg_max(Timestamp, ReportId), count() by DeviceId
options.zh: | summarize (Timestamp, ReportId)=arg_max(Timestamp, ReportId), count() by DeviceId

options.en: | summarize (Timestamp, DeviceName)=arg_min(Timestamp, DeviceName), count() by DeviceId
options.zh: | summarize (Timestamp, DeviceName)=arg_min(Timestamp, DeviceName), count() by DeviceId

questions.explanation_zh: 自定义检测规则要求输出 Timestamp 列，并需 ReportId 与设备标识定位事件。arg_max(Timestamp, ReportId) 在按 DeviceId 分组后取最新时间并带回对应 ReportId，再与 count() 组合汇总。make_set 只产生数组、range 生成时间范围、arg_min 取最早记录，均不满足该结构要求。

questions.en:
HOTSPOT
-

You have a Microsoft 365 E5 subscription that uses Microsoft Defender for Office 365.

You need to build a hunting query that will list events involving potentially malicious emails that were detected but NOT
removed successfully from mailboxes after delivery. The solution must ensure that the events are correlated with the
sign-in events of the email recipients.

How should you complete the query? To answer, select the appropriate options in the answer area.

NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.
questions.zh:
HOTSPOT -
你有一个使用 Microsoft Defender for Office 365 的 Microsoft 365 E5 订阅。

你需要构建一个威胁搜寻查询，用于列出涉及在投递后被检测到但未能成功从邮箱中移除的潜在恶意电子邮件的事件。解决方案必须确保这些事件与电子邮件收件人的登录事件相关联。

你应如何补全该查询？要回答，请在答案区域选择相应的选项。

注：每个正确选择值 1 分。

slots.zh: 空 2 · 联接使用的字段

questions.explanation_zh: 投递后被 ZAP 清除但未成功的事件，其 ActionType 为 ZAP 且 ActionResult 为 Error；AIR 是自动调查、XDR 是平台名称，都不是投递动作类型。关联登录事件时只有 IdentityLogonEvents 的 AccountUpn 能与收件人邮箱直接匹配，AccountSid 与 AccountObjectId 无法关联。

questions.en:
HOTSPOT
-

You have a Microsoft 365 E5 subscription that uses Microsoft Defender XDR.

You discover a malicious process that was initiated by a file named File1.exe on a device named Device1.

You need to create a KQL query that will identify when File1.exe was created. The solution must meet the following
requirements:

• Return the FileName, InitiatingProcessFileName, and InitiatingProcessCommandLine columns.
• Minimize the volume of data returned.

How should you complete the query? To answer, select the appropriate options in the answer area.

NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.
questions.zh:
HOTSPOT -
你有一个使用 Microsoft Defender XDR 的 Microsoft 365 E5 订阅。

你在名为 Device1 的设备上发现一个由名为 File1.exe 的文件启动的恶意进程。

你需要创建一个 KQL 查询，用于确定 File1.exe 的创建时间。解决方案必须满足以下要求：

• 返回 FileName、InitiatingProcessFileName 和 InitiatingProcessCommandLine 列。
• 尽量减少返回的数据量。

你应如何补全该查询？要回答，请在答案区域选择相应的选项。

注：每个正确选择值 1 分。
questions.explanation_zh: 文件创建事件记录在 DeviceFileEvents，配合 ActionType == FileCreated 与 FileName 可定位 File1.exe；DeviceProcessEvents 记录进程、DeviceRegistryEvents 记录注册表，均不合适。要最小化返回数据量，project-keep 只保留指定三列，project-away 会保留其余全部列，数据更多。

questions.en:
DRAG DROP
-

You have an Azure subscription that contains a Microsoft Sentinel workspace.

You need to create and customize a workbook for the Microsoft Entra ID Audit Logs.

Which three actions should you perform in sequence? To answer, move the appropriate actions from the list of actions
to the answer area and arrange them in the correct order.
questions.zh:
拖放（DRAG DROP）
你有一个 Azure 订阅，其中包含一个 Microsoft Sentinel 工作区。

你需要为 Microsoft Entra ID 审核日志创建并自定义工作簿。

你应依次执行哪三项操作？要回答，请将相应的操作从操作列表移到答案区域，并按正确顺序排列。

options.en: From Workbooks, select Microsoft Entra ID Audit logs and then select Save.
options.zh: 在“工作簿”中选择 Microsoft Entra ID Audit logs，然后选择“保存”

options.en: From Content hub, install the Microsoft Entra ID solution.
options.zh: 在内容中心安装 Microsoft Entra ID 解决方案

options.en: From Workbooks, select Microsoft Entra ID Audit logs and then select View saved workbook.
options.zh: 在“工作簿”中选择 Microsoft Entra ID Audit logs，然后选择“查看已保存的工作簿”
启用 Workspace manager（工作区管理器）

options.en: From Workbooks, select Microsoft Entra ID Audit logs and then select View Template.
options.zh: 在“工作簿”中选择 Microsoft Entra ID Audit logs，然后选择“查看模板”

options.en: From Workbooks, select Microsoft Entra ID Audit logs and then select Save.
options.zh: 在“工作簿”中选择 Microsoft Entra ID Audit logs，然后选择“保存”

options.en: From Content hub, install the Microsoft Entra ID solution.
options.zh: 在内容中心安装 Microsoft Entra ID 解决方案

options.en: From Workbooks, select Microsoft Entra ID Audit logs and then select View saved workbook.
options.zh: 在“工作簿”中选择 Microsoft Entra ID Audit logs，然后选择“查看已保存的工作簿”
启用 Workspace manager（工作区管理器）

options.en: From Workbooks, select Microsoft Entra ID Audit logs and then select View Template.
options.zh: 在“工作簿”中选择 Microsoft Entra ID Audit logs，然后选择“查看模板”

options.en: From Workbooks, select Microsoft Entra ID Audit logs and then select Save.
options.zh: 在“工作簿”中选择 Microsoft Entra ID Audit logs，然后选择“保存”

options.en: From Content hub, install the Microsoft Entra ID solution.
options.zh: 在内容中心安装 Microsoft Entra ID 解决方案

options.en: From Workbooks, select Microsoft Entra ID Audit logs and then select View saved workbook.
options.zh: 在“工作簿”中选择 Microsoft Entra ID Audit logs，然后选择“查看已保存的工作簿”
启用 Workspace manager（工作区管理器）

options.en: From Workbooks, select Microsoft Entra ID Audit logs and then select View Template.
options.zh: 在“工作簿”中选择 Microsoft Entra ID Audit logs，然后选择“查看模板”

questions.explanation_zh: 先在内容中心安装 Microsoft Entra ID 解决方案，才会部署官方工作簿模板；再配置数据连接器把审核日志接入工作区，工作簿才有数据可查。模板本身不可直接编辑，需选择“查看保存的工作簿”打开可保存的副本后再自定义；“查看模板”只读，无法保存修改。

questions.en:
HOTSPOT
-

You have an Azure subscription named Sub1 that contains a Microsoft Sentinel workspace named WS1.

You need to create a hunting query in WS1 that meets the following requirements:

• Returns the number of changes performed daily by each Microsoft Entra security principal during a seven-day period
• Identifies all the successful changes to the resources in Sub1
• Substitutes any missing data points with 0

How should you complete the KQL query? To answer, select the appropriate options in the answer area.

NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.
questions.zh:
HOTSPOT -
你有一个名为 Sub1 的 Azure 订阅，其中包含一个名为 WS1 的 Microsoft Sentinel 工作区。

你需要在 WS1 中创建一个满足以下要求的威胁搜寻查询：

• 返回七天期间内每个 Microsoft Entra 安全主体每天执行的更改次数
• 识别对 Sub1 中资源的所有成功更改
• 将任何缺失的数据点替换为 0

你应如何补全该 KQL 查询？要回答，请在答案区域选择相应的选项。

注：每个正确选择值 1 分。
questions.explanation_zh: 资源写操作成功记录应查 AzureActivity，AuditLogs 是 Entra 审核日志、AzureDiagnostics 是资源诊断日志。要求按天返回并补 0，须用 make-series default=0 on EventSubmissionTimestamp in range(ago(7d), now(), 1d)；summarize 不生成缺失日期的数据点，无法满足补零要求。

questions.en:
HOTSPOT
-

You have a Microsoft Sentinel workbook that contains the following KQL query.













You need to create a visual that will change the color of the errCount column based on the value returned.

How should you configure the visual? To answer, select the appropriate options in the answer area.

NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.
questions.zh:
HOTSPOT -
你有一个 Microsoft Sentinel 工作簿，其中包含以下 KQL 查询。

你需要创建一个可视化，根据返回的值更改 errCount 列的颜色。

你应如何配置该可视化？要回答，请在答案区域选择相应的选项。

注：每个正确选择值 1 分。
questions.explanation_zh: 查询结果是含 errCount 等多列的表格，要按数值给该列着色应使用 Grid 可视化并选择 Heatmap 列渲染器，它把数值高低映射为不同底色，直观呈现错误量分布。Graph 适合时序趋势，Text 只能显示文本，Big number 只适用于单值；Thresholds 需逐条手工设阈值，题库答案为 Heatmap。

questions.en:
You have a Microsoft 365 subscription that uses Microsoft Defender XDR. The subscription contains 500 Windows 11
devices that are onboarded to Microsoft Defender for Endpoint.

You discover unauthorized changes to the membership of the Administrators group for the devices.

You need to configure a solution that meets the following requirements:

• Every hour, check the Administrators group membership of each endpoint.
• When a change to the Administrators group membership is detected, create an incident in Microsoft Defender XDR.

What should you create first?
questions.zh:
你有一个使用 Microsoft Defender XDR 的 Microsoft 365 订阅。该订阅包含 500 台已载入 Microsoft Defender for Endpoint 的 Windows 11 设备。

你发现这些设备的 Administrators 组成员身份发生了未经授权的更改。

你需要配置一个满足以下要求的解决方案：

• 每小时检查每个终结点的 Administrators 组成员身份。
• 当检测到 Administrators 组成员身份更改时，在 Microsoft Defender XDR 中创建事件。

你应首先创建什么？

options.zh: 警报优化规则（alert tuning rule）

questions.explanation_zh: 题目问的是“首先要创建什么”：检测逻辑本身来自 KQL 查询，必须先在高级搜寻里把“本地 Administrators 组成员变化”的查询写出来并验证（DeviceEvents 里 UserAccountAddedToLocalGroup / UserAccountRemovedFromLocalGroup 一类事件），再基于它创建自定义检测规则、设定每小时运行并生成事件。设备组、警报优化规则都不执行查询，检测规则也要依附已存在的查询，所以第一步只能是高级搜寻查询（社区 100% 认同）。

questions.en:
HOTSPOT
-

You have a Microsoft 365 E5 subscription that uses Microsoft Defender XDR.

Your network contains an on-premises Active Directory Domain Services (AD DS) domain that syncs with a Microsoft
Entra tenant.

You need to identify the 100 most recent sign-in attempts recorded on devices and AD DS domain controllers.

How should you complete the KQL query? To answer, select the appropriate options in the answer area.

NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.
questions.zh:
HOTSPOT -
你有一个使用 Microsoft Defender XDR 的 Microsoft 365 E5 订阅。

你的网络包含一个与 Microsoft Entra 租户同步的本地 Active Directory 域服务（AD DS）域。

你需要确定在设备和 AD DS 域控制器上记录的最新 100 次登录尝试。

你应如何补全该 KQL 查询？要回答，请在答案区域选择相应的选项。

注：每个正确选择值 1 分。
questions.explanation_zh: 要同时覆盖设备上的登录（DeviceLogonEvents）与 AD DS 域控上的登录（IdentityLogonEvents），需用 union 把两张表纵向合并；join 依赖匹配键，且无法合并结构不同的表。合并时两段各 take 100，最后按 Timestamp 排序，即可得到最近的 100 次登录尝试。

questions.en:
HOTSPOT
-

You have a Microsoft Sentinel workspace named Workspace1.

You need to create a custom workbook in Workspace1. Workspace1 must display a time chart that shows failed
Microsoft Entra sign-ins from the past seven days. The solution must ensure that the chart includes a count of failed sign-
ins for each day.

How should you complete the KQL query? To answer, select the appropriate options in the answer area.

NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.
questions.zh:
HOTSPOT -
你有一个名为 Workspace1 的 Microsoft Sentinel 工作区。

你需要在 Workspace1 中创建自定义工作簿。Workspace1 必须显示一个时间图表，展示过去七天 Microsoft Entra 登录失败情况。解决方案必须确保图表包含每天的登录失败计数。

你应如何补全该 KQL 查询？要回答，请在答案区域选择相应的选项。

注：每个正确选择值 1 分。
questions.explanation_zh: 按天统计失败登录数要用 summarize Count=count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1d)，先把时间戳按一天分桶再 render timechart，即得每天一个数据点的趋势。make-series 需 on 与 in range 的完整语法且本题未给出，extend 不能聚合；TimeFrame 与 default=0 片段也不匹配 summarize 语法。

questions.en:
HOTSPOT
-

You have a Microsoft 365 E5 subscription that uses Microsoft Defender XDR.

You have an Azure subscription that contains a Log Analytics workspace named Workspace1.

You forward all logs to Workspace1.

You need to identify all the applications and security principals that made requests to modify Microsoft Entra groups
during the previous 24 hours.

How should you complete the KQL query? To answer, select the appropriate options in the answer area.

NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.
questions.zh:
HOTSPOT -
你有一个使用 Microsoft Defender XDR 的 Microsoft 365 E5 订阅。

你有一个 Azure 订阅，其中包含一个名为 Workspace1 的 Log Analytics 工作区。

你将所有日志转发到 Workspace1。

你需要识别在过去 24 小时内请求修改 Microsoft Entra 组的所有应用程序和安全主体。

你应如何补全该 KQL 查询？要回答，请在答案区域选择相应的选项。

注：每个正确选择值 1 分。
questions.explanation_zh: 记录应用与服务主体经 Microsoft Graph 对 /groups 发起修改请求的日志在 MicrosoftGraphActivityLogs 表，另两表不含完整请求 URL 与 HTTP 方法。修改类请求的方法值为 PUT（GET 为读取、POST 为创建），故第二空选 PUT，再按 AppId、UserId、ServicePrincipalId 统计请求数。

questions.en:
You have a Microsoft 365 subscription that uses Microsoft Defender XDR, Microsoft Purview, and Exchange Online.

You have a partner company named Contoso, Ltd.

You need to review all the emails that contain PDF attachments and were received from Contoso during the past month.
The solution must minimize administrative effort.

What should you use?
questions.zh:
你有一个使用 Microsoft Defender XDR、Microsoft Purview 和 Exchange Online 的 Microsoft 365 订阅。

你有一个名为 Contoso, Ltd. 的合作伙伴公司。

你需要查看过去一个月内来自 Contoso、且包含 PDF 附件的所有电子邮件。解决方案必须尽量减少管理工作量。

你应使用什么？
questions.explanation_zh: 审查过去一个月含 PDF 附件且来自 Contoso 的邮件，本质是跨邮箱的条件检索，Microsoft Purview 内容搜索支持发件人域与附件类型组合的 KQL，可批量命中并导出，配置开销最小。内容探索器只展示已被 DLP 或保留标签分类的内容，不能任意条件检索；活动资源管理器只有近 30 天的审核活动而非邮件内容。

questions.en:
You have an Azure subscription that uses Microsoft Sentinel.

You need to create a custom workbook that will calculate the average time it takes to close security incidents. The
solution must minimize administrative effort.

Which built-in Microsoft Sentinel workbook template should you select?
questions.zh:
你有一个使用 Microsoft Sentinel 的 Azure 订阅。

你需要创建一个自定义工作簿，用于计算关闭安全事件所需的平均时间。解决方案必须尽量减少管理工作量。

你应选择哪个内置 Microsoft Sentinel 工作簿模板？
questions.explanation_zh: Sentinel 内置的“安全业务效率”工作簿模板专门呈现 SOC 效率指标，包括事件的平均确认与关闭时间（MTTA/MTTR）、按严重性和状态分布等，可直接用来计算关闭事件的平均耗时。事件概况侧重单个事件的上下文，工作区使用报告统计查询量与成本，调查透视面向实体与调查图分析。

questions.en:
You have a Microsoft 365 subscription that uses Microsoft Defender for Endpoint Plan 2. The subscription contains
1,000 Windows 11 devices that run a third-party antivirus software and have Smart App Control enabled.

You need to ensure that if Defender for Endpoint detects a malicious artifact that was missed by the third-party software,
it will remediate the artifact automatically.

What should you configure?
questions.zh:
你有一个使用 Microsoft Defender for Endpoint 计划 2 的 Microsoft 365 订阅。该订阅包含 1,000 台运行第三方防病毒软件并启用了智能应用控制（Smart App Control）的 Windows 11 设备。

你需要确保当 Defender for Endpoint 检测到被第三方软件遗漏的恶意项目时，会自动修复该项。

你应配置什么？

options.en: endpoint detection and response (EDR) in block mode
options.zh: 阻止模式下的终结点检测和响应（EDR）
允许或阻止文件（Allow or block file）

questions.explanation_zh: 设备运行第三方防病毒并启用 Smart App Control 时，Defender for Endpoint 处于被动模式，默认只检测不处置。启用 EDR 阻止模式后，Defender 能对自身检测到的恶意制品执行阻断与自动修复，弥补第三方软件漏检。允许/阻止文件需手工维护哈希，自动解决警报只改状态，防篡改保护保护的是 Defender 自身设置。

questions.en:
You have a Microsoft 365 subscription. The subscription contains 500 devices that are onboarded to Microsoft
Defender for Endpoint.

You have an Azure subscription that contains a Microsoft Sentinel workspace.

You need to run a pilot on 50 devices that will remediate threats automatically. The solution must meet the following
requirements:

• Minimize the impact on devices that are excluded from the pilot.
• Minimize administrative effort.

What should you configure first?
questions.zh:
你有一个 Microsoft 365 订阅。该订阅包含 500 台已载入 Microsoft Defender for Endpoint 的设备。

你有一个包含 Microsoft Sentinel 工作区的 Azure 订阅。

你需要在一项试点中让 50 台设备自动修复威胁。解决方案必须满足以下要求：

• 尽量减少对试点范围外设备的影响。
• 尽量减少管理工作量。

你应首先配置什么？
questions.explanation_zh: 先在 Defender for Endpoint 中创建只包含这 50 台设备的设备组，再把该组的自动化级别设为“完全修复”，试点设备即可自动修复威胁，其余 450 台不受影响。设备组是自动化级别和攻击面减少策略的应用边界；直接建 Playbook 或自动化规则无法按设备范围限定，且管理开销更大。

questions.en:
HOTSPOT
-

You have a Microsoft 365 E5 subscription that uses Microsoft Defender XDR.

You need to create a hunting query in KQL that meets the following requirements:

• Identifies any devices that received an email containing an attachment named File1.pdf during the last 12 hours and
opened the attachment.
• Minimizes the resources required to run the query

How should you complete the query? To answer, select the appropriate options in the answer area.

NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.
questions.zh:
HOTSPOT -
你有一个使用 Microsoft Defender XDR 的 Microsoft 365 E5 订阅。

你需要创建一个满足以下要求的 KQL 威胁搜寻查询：

• 识别过去 12 小时内收到含名为 File1.pdf 附件的电子邮件、并打开了该附件的任何设备。
• 尽量减少运行该查询所需的资源。

你应如何补全该查询？要回答，请在答案区域选择相应的选项。

注：每个正确选择值 1 分。
questions.explanation_zh: join 默认的 innerunique 会按共享键去重，资源开销最小；关联邮件附件与设备文件事件需用 FileOriginUrl 作为匹配列，DeviceFileEvents 记录的文件来源 URL 与 EmailAttachmentInfo 同名字段一致。FilePath 是本地路径、SHA256 是哈希，无法关联，inner 或 rightouter 还会产生重复行。

questions.en:
HOTSPOT
-

You have a Microsoft Sentinel workspace.

You have a KQL query. The query returns Microsoft Sentinel incidents that are stored in the SecurityIncident table and
occurred during the last 90 days.

You need to create a Microsoft Sentinel workbook that will include a visualization of the query.

To what should you set Data source and Resource type for the workbook? To answer, select the appropriate options in
the answer area.

NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.
questions.zh:
HOTSPOT -
你有一个 Microsoft Sentinel 工作区。

你有一个 KQL 查询。该查询返回存储在 SecurityIncident 表中、发生在过去 90 天内的 Microsoft Sentinel 事件。

你需要创建包含该查询可视化的 Microsoft Sentinel 工作簿。

你应为该工作簿将“数据源”和“资源类型”设置为什么？要回答，请在答案区域选择相应的选项。

注：每个正确选择值 1 分。
questions.explanation_zh: SecurityIncident 表存放在 Sentinel 背后的 Log Analytics 工作区中，工作簿查询这类日志表时数据源应选 Logs (Analytics)，资源类型选 Log Analytics 才能指定目标工作区并执行 KQL。Logs (Basic) 是低成本基础日志层，Azure Resource Graph 面向资源元数据，均不支持该表查询。

questions.en:
You have 1,000 on-premises Windows 11 Pro devices that are onboarded to Microsoft Defender for Endpoint.

You have a Microsoft 365 subscription that uses Microsoft Defender XDR.

You identify that an attacker performed the following actions on a device:

• Modified the file system path of a registry-based antivirus exclusion
• Downloaded a malicious file to the file system path

You initiate a live response session on the device.

You need to remove the malicious file.

Which command should you run?
questions.zh:
你有 1,000 台已载入 Microsoft Defender for Endpoint 的本地 Windows 11 专业版设备。

你有一个使用 Microsoft Defender XDR 的 Microsoft 365 订阅。

你发现攻击者在一台设备上执行了以下操作：

• 修改了基于注册表的防病毒排除项的文件系统路径
• 将恶意文件下载到该文件系统路径

你在该设备上启动实时响应会话。

你需要删除该恶意文件。

你应运行哪个命令？
questions.explanation_zh: remediate 命令对检测到的恶意文件或实体执行修复动作（删除或隔离），可直接清除攻击者下载到该路径的恶意文件。getfile 只是把文件取回本地取证，collect 收集调查证据包，undo 并非实时响应命令，都不真正删除设备上的文件。

questions.en:
You have a Microsoft 365 subscription that uses Microsoft Defender XDR. All endpoint devices are onboarded to
Microsoft Defender for Endpoint.

You have an Azure subscription that contains a Microsoft Sentinel workspace named Workspace1. All Microsoft
Defender XDR events are ingested into Workspace1.

You have a Microsoft Entra tenant.

You create a KQL query named query1 that searches device logs for a known vulnerability.

You need to ensure that query1 runs every hour. The solution must minimize administrative effort.

What should you configure?
questions.zh:
你有一个使用 Microsoft Defender XDR 的 Microsoft 365 订阅。所有终结点设备都已载入 Microsoft Defender for Endpoint。

你有一个包含名为 Workspace1 的 Microsoft Sentinel 工作区的 Azure 订阅。所有 Microsoft Defender XDR 事件都已引入 Workspace1。

你有一个 Microsoft Entra 租户。

你创建了一条名为 query1 的 KQL 查询，用于在设备日志中搜索已知漏洞。

你需要确保 query1 每小时运行一次。解决方案必须尽量减少管理工作量。

你应配置什么？
questions.explanation_zh: Defender XDR 自定义检测规则直接以 KQL 查询为检测逻辑，可设置每小时或每 24 小时运行，命中后生成警报和事件，无需其他组件，管理开销最小。自动化规则只对已有警报或事件执行动作、不运行查询；监视列表仅是查询可引用的数据表；自动调查与响应负责调查处置而非定时检测。

questions.en: The issue for which team can be resolved by using Microsoft Defender for Endpoint?
questions.zh: 使用 Microsoft Defender for Endpoint 解决哪个团队的问题？
questions.explanation_zh: 销售团队只使用 iOS 设备，通过第三方工具交换文件且遭遇过钓鱼攻击，这些移动端威胁（钓鱼链接、恶意网络请求、设备风险）由 Microsoft Defender for Endpoint 的移动威胁防御覆盖，因此销售团队的问题用 MDE 解决。营销团队是 SharePoint 恶意文件问题，属 Defender for Office 365；执行团队的文件活动统计属云应用安全。
questions.case_en:
Introductory Info

Case study -
This is a case study. Case studies are not timed separately. You can use as much exam time as you would like to
complete each case. However, there may be additional case studies and sections on this exam. You must manage your
time to ensure that you are able to complete all questions included on this exam in the time provided

. To answer the questions included in a case study, you will need to reference information that is provided in the case
study. Case studies might contain exhibits and other resources that provide more information about the scenario that is
described in the case study. Each question is independent of the other questions in this case study.

At the end of this case study, a review screen will appear. This screen allows you to review your answers and to make
changes before you move to the next section of the exam. After you begin a new section, you cannot return to this
section.

To start the case study -
To display the first question in this case study, click the Next button. Use the buttons in the left pane to explore the
content of the case study before you answer the questions. Clicking these buttons displays information such as business
requirements, existing environment, and problem statements. If the case study has an All Information tab, note that the
information displayed is identical to the information displayed on the subsequent tabs. When you are ready to answer a
question, click the Question button to return to the question.

Overview -
A company named Contoso Ltd. has a main office and five branch offices located throughout North America. The main
office is in Seattle. The branch offices are in Toronto, Miami, Houston, Los Angeles, and Vancouver. Contoso has a
subsidiary named Fabrikam, Ltd. that has offices in New York and San Francisco.

Existing Environment -

End - User Environment -
All users at Contoso use Windows 10 devices. Each user is licensed for Microsoft 365. In addition, iOS devices are
ers of the  sales  team   at  Contoso
distributed to the members of the sales team at Contoso.

Cloud and Hybrid Infrastructure -
All Contoso applications are deployed to Azure.
You enable Microsoft Cloud App Security.
Contoso and Fabrikam have different Azure Active Directory (Azure AD) tenants. Fabrikam recently purchased an Azure
subscription and enabled Azure Defender for all supported resource types.

Current Problems -
The security team at Contoso receives a large number of cybersecurity alerts. The security team spends too much time
identifying which cybersecurity alerts are legitimate threats, and which are not.
The Contoso sales team uses only iOS devices. The sales team members exchange files with customers by using a
variety of third-party tools. In the past, the sales team experienced phishing attacks on their devices.
The marketing team at Contoso has several Microsoft SharePoint Online sites for collaborating with external vendors.
The marketing team has had several incidents in which vendors uploaded files that contain malware.
The executive team at Contoso suspects a security breach. The executive team requests that you identify which files had
more than five activities during the past 48 hours, including data access, download, or deletion for Microsoft Cloud App
Security-protected applications.

Requirements -

Planned Changes -
Contoso plans to integrate the security operations of both companies and manage all security operations centrally.

Technical Requirements -
Contoso identifies the following technical requirements:
Receive alerts if an Azure virtual machine is under brute force attack.
Use Azure Sentinel to reduce organizational risk by rapidly remediating active attacks on the environment.
Implement Azure Sentinel queries that correlate data across the Azure AD tenants of Contoso and Fabrikam.
Develop a procedure to remediate Azure Defender for Key Vault alerts for Fabrikam in case of external attackers and a
potential compromise of its own Azure AD applications.
Identify all cases of users who failed to sign in to an Azure resource for the first time from a given country. A junior
security administrator provides you with the following incomplete query.

BehaviorAnalytics -
| where ActivityType == "FailedLogOn"
| where ______ == True

Question
questions.case_zh:
介绍信息

案例研究 -
本部分为案例研究。案例研究不计时。你可以按需花费任意多的考试时间完成每个案例。不过，本考试中可能还有其他案例研究和部分。你必须合理安排时间，确保在规定时间内完成本考试包含的所有题目。
要回答案例研究中包含的题目，你需要参考案例研究中提供的信息。案例研究可能包含展品和其他资源，提供有关案例研究所述场景的更多信息。每道题都与本案例研究中的其他题目相互独立。

在本案例研究结束时，将出现复查屏幕。该屏幕允许你在进入考试下一部分之前复查答案并进行更改。开始新的部分后，你无法返回本部分。

启动案例研究 -
要显示本案例研究的第一道题，请单击“下一步”按钮。在回答题目之前，可使用左窗格中的按钮浏览案例研究的内容。单击这些按钮会显示业务要求、现有环境和问题陈述等信息。如果案例研究有“所有信息”选项卡，请注意该选项卡显示的信息与后续选项卡显示的信息相同。准备好回答问题时，请单击“问题”按钮返回该题目。

概述 -
一家名为 Contoso Ltd. 的公司在美国各地设有一个总部和五个分支机构。总部位于西雅图。分支机构分别位于多伦多、迈阿密、休斯敦、洛杉矶和温哥华。Contoso 有一家名为 Fabrikam, Ltd. 的子公司，在纽约和旧金山设有办公室。

现有环境 -

最终用户环境 -
Contoso 的所有用户都使用 Windows 10 设备。每个用户都拥有 Microsoft 365 许可证。此外，还会向 Contoso 销售团队的成员分发 iOS 设备。

云和混合基础结构 -
所有 Contoso 应用程序都部署到 Azure。
你启用 Microsoft Cloud App Security。
Contoso 和 Fabrikam 使用不同的 Azure Active Directory（Azure AD）租户。Fabrikam 最近购买了 Azure 订阅，并为所有受支持的资源类型启用了 Azure Defender。

当前问题 -
Contoso 的安全团队收到大量网络安全警报。安全团队花了太多时间来辨别哪些网络安全警报是真正的威胁、哪些不是。
Contoso 销售团队仅使用 iOS 设备。销售团队成员通过多种第三方工具与客户交换文件。过去，销售团队在其设备上遭遇过网络钓鱼攻击。
Contoso 的市场营销团队有多个用于与外部供应商协作的 Microsoft SharePoint Online 网站。该团队发生过几起供应商上传含恶意软件文件的事件。
Contoso 的高管团队怀疑发生了安全泄露。高管团队要求你找出过去 48 小时内活动次数超过五次的文件，活动包括对 Microsoft Cloud App Security 所保护应用程序的数据访问、下载或删除。

要求 -

计划的变更 -
Contoso 计划整合两家公司的安全运营，并集中管理所有安全运营。

技术要求 -
Contoso 确定了以下技术要求：
当 Azure 虚拟机遭受暴力破解攻击时接收警报。
使用 Azure Sentinel 通过快速修复环境中的活动攻击来降低组织风险。
实现可跨 Contoso 和 Fabrikam 的 Azure AD 租户关联数据的 Azure Sentinel 查询。
制定一个流程：在 Fabrikam 遇到外部攻击者以及自身 Azure AD 应用程序可能被入侵时，修复 Fabrikam 的 Azure Defender for Key Vault 警报。
找出所有用户首次从某个国家/地区登录 Azure 资源失败的情况。一名初级安全管理员向你提供了以下不完整的查询。

BehaviorAnalytics -
| where ActivityType == "FailedLogOn"
| where ______ == True

问题

questions.en: The issue for which team can be resolved by using Microsoft Defender for Office 365?
questions.zh: 哪个团队的问题可以通过使用 Microsoft Defender for Office 365 解决？
questions.explanation_zh: 营销团队在 SharePoint Online 与外部供应商协作，供应商上传了带恶意软件的文件，需由 Defender for Office 365 的安全附件、安全链接对 SharePoint、OneDrive、Teams 中的文件进行检测与阻断。Defender for Endpoint 覆盖终端与移动设备，云应用安全负责应用发现与文件活动异常，都不能直接清理文档库中的恶意文件。

ent -
Microsoft 365 Environment -

is deployed to all computers that run Windows 10. All Microsoft Cloud App Security built-in anomaly detection policies
are enabled.

Azure Environment -
Litware has an Azure subscription linked to the litware.com Azure AD tenant. The subscription contains resources in the
East US Azure region as shown in the following table.








Network Environment -

Azure subscription.

On-premises Environment -
The on-premises network contains the computers shown in the following table.







Current problems -
Cloud App Security frequently generates false positive alerts when users connect to both offices simultaneously.

Planned Changes -
Litware plans to implement the following changes:
Create and configure Azure Sentinel in the Azure subscription.
Validate Azure Sentinel functionality by using Azure AD test user accounts.

Business Requirements -

The principle of least privilege must be used whenever possible.
Costs must be minimized, as long as all other requirements are met.

All domain controllers must be protected by using Microsoft Defender for Identity.

Information Protection " Data discovery dashboard.

for Endpoint.

playbook.
Add notes to events that represent data access from a specific IP address to provide the ability to reference the IP
address when navigating through an investigation graph while hunting.
Create a test rule that generates alerts when inbound access to Microsoft Office 365 by the Azure AD test user accounts
is detected. Alerts generated by the rule must be grouped into individual incidents, with one incident per test user
account.

Overview -
Litware Inc. is a renewable energy company.
Litware has offices in Boston and Seattle. Litware also has remote users located across the United States. To access
Litware resources, including cloud resources, the remote users establish a VPN connection to either office.

Existing Environment -

Identity Environment -
The network contains an Active Directory forest named litware.com that syncs to an Azure Active Directory (Azure AD)
tenant named litware.com.

ent -
Microsoft 365 Environment -
Litware has a Microsoft 365 E5 subscription linked to the litware.com Azure AD tenant. Microsoft Defender for Endpoint
is deployed to all computers that run Windows 10. All Microsoft Cloud App Security built-in anomaly detection policies
are enabled.

Azure Environment -
Litware has an Azure subscription linked to the litware.com Azure AD tenant. The subscription contains resources in the
East US Azure region as shown in the following table.








Network Environment -
Each Litware office connects directly to the internet and has a site-to-site VPN connection to the virtual networks in the
Azure subscription.

On-premises Environment -
The on-premises network contains the computers shown in the following table.







Current problems -
Cloud App Security frequently generates false positive alerts when users connect to both offices simultaneously.

Planned Changes and Requirements
Planned Changes -
Litware plans to implement the following changes:
Create and configure Azure Sentinel in the Azure subscription.
Validate Azure Sentinel functionality by using Azure AD test user accounts.

Business Requirements -
Litware identifies the following business requirements:
The principle of least privilege must be used whenever possible.
Costs must be minimized, as long as all other requirements are met.
Logs collected by Log Analytics must provide a full audit trail of user activities.
All domain controllers must be protected by using Microsoft Defender for Identity.

Azure Information Protection Requirements
All files that have security labels and are stored on the Windows 10 computers must be available from the Azure
Information Protection " Data discovery dashboard.

Microsoft Defender for Endpoint requirements
All Cloud App Security unsanctioned apps must be blocked on the Windows 10 computers by using Microsoft Defender
for Endpoint.

Microsoft Cloud App Security requirements
tidentify  whether   a  user  connection    is anomalous      based   on  tenant-level   data.
Azure Defender Requirements -
All servers must send logs to the same Log Analytics workspace.

Azure Sentinel Requirements -
Litware must meet the following Azure Sentinel requirements:
Integrate Azure Sentinel and Cloud App Security.
Ensure that a user named admin1 can configure Azure Sentinel playbooks.
Create an Azure Sentinel analytics rule based on a custom query. The rule must automatically initiate the execution of a
playbook.
Add notes to events that represent data access from a specific IP address to provide the ability to reference the IP
address when navigating through an investigation graph while hunting.
Create a test rule that generates alerts when inbound access to Microsoft Office 365 by the Azure AD test user accounts
is detected. Alerts generated by the rule must be grouped into individual incidents, with one incident per test user
account.

Overview -
A company named Contoso Ltd. has a main office and five branch offices located throughout North America. The main
office is in Seattle. The branch offices are in Toronto, Miami, Houston, Los Angeles, and Vancouver. Contoso has a
subsidiary named Fabrikam, Ltd. that has offices in New York and San Francisco.

Existing Environment -

End - User Environment -
All users at Contoso use Windows 10 devices. Each user is licensed for Microsoft 365. In addition, iOS devices are
ers of the  sales  team   at  Contoso
distributed to the members of the sales team at Contoso.

Cloud and Hybrid Infrastructure -
All Contoso applications are deployed to Azure.
You enable Microsoft Cloud App Security.
Contoso and Fabrikam have different Azure Active Directory (Azure AD) tenants. Fabrikam recently purchased an Azure

Current Problems -
The security team at Contoso receives a large number of cybersecurity alerts. The security team spends too much time
identifying which cybersecurity alerts are legitimate threats, and which are not.
The Contoso sales team uses only iOS devices. The sales team members exchange files with customers by using a
variety of third-party tools. In the past, the sales team experienced phishing attacks on their devices.
The marketing team at Contoso has several Microsoft SharePoint Online sites for collaborating with external vendors.
The marketing team has had several incidents in which vendors uploaded files that contain malware.
The executive team at Contoso suspects a security breach. The executive team requests that you identify which files had
more than five activities during the past 48 hours, including data access, download, or deletion for Microsoft Cloud App
Security-protected applications.

Requirements -

Receive alerts if an Azure virtual machine is under brute force attack.
Use Azure Sentinel to reduce organizational risk by rapidly remediating active attacks on the environment.
Implement Azure Sentinel queries that correlate data across the Azure AD tenants of Contoso and Fabrikam.
Develop a procedure to remediate Azure Defender for Key Vault alerts for Fabrikam in case of external attackers and a
potential compromise of its own Azure AD applications.
Identify all cases of users who failed to sign in to an Azure resource for the first time from a given country. A junior
security administrator provides you with the following incomplete query.

BehaviorAnalytics -
| where ActivityType == "FailedLogOn"
| where ______ == True

现有环境 -

最终用户环境 -
Contoso 的所有用户都使用 Windows 10 设备。每个用户都拥有 Microsoft 365 许可证。此外，还会向 Contoso 销售团队的成员分发 iOS 设备。

所有 Contoso 应用程序都部署到 Azure。

当前问题 -
Contoso 的安全团队收到大量网络安全警报。安全团队花了太多时间来辨别哪些网络安全警报是真正的威胁、哪些不是。
Contoso 销售团队仅使用 iOS 设备。销售团队成员通过多种第三方工具与客户交换文件。过去，销售团队在其设备上遭遇过网络钓鱼攻击。
Contoso 的市场营销团队有多个用于与外部供应商协作的 Microsoft SharePoint Online 网站。该团队发生过几起供应商上传含恶意软件文件的事件。
Contoso 的高管团队怀疑发生了安全泄露。高管团队要求你找出过去 48 小时内活动次数超过五次的文件，活动包括对 Microsoft Cloud App Security 所保护应用程序的数据访问、下载或删除。

计划的变更 -
Contoso 计划整合两家公司的安全运营，并集中管理所有安全运营。

当 Azure 虚拟机遭受暴力破解攻击时接收警报。
使用 Azure Sentinel 通过快速修复环境中的活动攻击来降低组织风险。
实现可跨 Contoso 和 Fabrikam 的 Azure AD 租户关联数据的 Azure Sentinel 查询。
制定一个流程：在 Fabrikam 遇到外部攻击者以及自身 Azure AD 应用程序可能被入侵时，修复 Fabrikam 的 Azure Defender for Key Vault 警报。
找出所有用户首次从某个国家/地区登录 Azure 资源失败的情况。一名初级安全管理员向你提供了以下不完整的查询。

BehaviorAnalytics -
| where ActivityType == "FailedLogOn"
| where ______ == True

You need to create an advanced hunting query to investigate the executive team issue.
How should you complete the query? To answer, select the appropriate options in the answer area.
NOTE: Each correct selection is worth one point.

questions.zh:
HOTSPOT -
你需要创建一个高级搜寻查询，以调查高管团队的问题。

你应如何补全该查询？要回答，请在答案区域选择相应的选项。

注：每个正确选择值 1 分。

Hot Area：
questions.explanation_zh: 统计文件访问、下载、删除等活动应查 DeviceFileEvents，它含 FolderPath、FileName、ActionType 字段；CloudAppEvents 与 DeviceProcessEvents 无这些字段。按这些列分组后用 count() 汇总，再以 activityCount > 5 筛出活动频繁的文件。

Overview -
Litware Inc. is a renewable energy company.
Litware has offices in Boston and Seattle. Litware also has remote users located across the United States. To access
Litware resources, including cloud resources, the remote users establish a VPN connection to either office.

Existing Environment -

Identity Environment -
The network contains an Active Directory forest named litware.com that syncs to an Azure Active Directory (Azure AD)
tenant named litware.com.

ent -
Microsoft 365 Environment -
Litware has a Microsoft 365 E5 subscription linked to the litware.com Azure AD tenant. Microsoft Defender for Endpoint
is deployed to all computers that run Windows 10. All Microsoft Cloud App Security built-in anomaly detection policies
are enabled.

Azure Environment -
Litware has an Azure subscription linked to the litware.com Azure AD tenant. The subscription contains resources in the
East US Azure region as shown in the following table.








Network Environment -
Each Litware office connects directly to the internet and has a site-to-site VPN connection to the virtual networks in the
Azure subscription.

On-premises Environment -
The on-premises network contains the computers shown in the following table.







Current problems -
Cloud App Security frequently generates false positive alerts when users connect to both offices simultaneously.

Planned Changes and Requirements
Planned Changes -
Litware plans to implement the following changes:
Create and configure Azure Sentinel in the Azure subscription.
Validate Azure Sentinel functionality by using Azure AD test user accounts.

Business Requirements -
Litware identifies the following business requirements:
The principle of least privilege must be used whenever possible.
Costs must be minimized, as long as all other requirements are met.
Logs collected by Log Analytics must provide a full audit trail of user activities.
All domain controllers must be protected by using Microsoft Defender for Identity.

Azure Information Protection Requirements
All files that have security labels and are stored on the Windows 10 computers must be available from the Azure
Information Protection " Data discovery dashboard.

Microsoft Defender for Endpoint requirements
All Cloud App Security unsanctioned apps must be blocked on the Windows 10 computers by using Microsoft Defender
for Endpoint.

Microsoft Cloud App Security requirements
tidentify  whether   a  user  connection    is anomalous      based   on  tenant-level   data.
Azure Defender Requirements -
All servers must send logs to the same Log Analytics workspace.

Azure Sentinel Requirements -
Litware must meet the following Azure Sentinel requirements:
Integrate Azure Sentinel and Cloud App Security.
Ensure that a user named admin1 can configure Azure Sentinel playbooks.
Create an Azure Sentinel analytics rule based on a custom query. The rule must automatically initiate the execution of a
playbook.
Add notes to events that represent data access from a specific IP address to provide the ability to reference the IP
address when navigating through an investigation graph while hunting.
Create a test rule that generates alerts when inbound access to Microsoft Office 365 by the Azure AD test user accounts
is detected. Alerts generated by the rule must be grouped into individual incidents, with one incident per test user
account.

Which role should you assign?

你应分配哪个角色？

options.zh: Automation Runbook Operator（自动化 Runbook 操作员）
Azure Sentinel Contributor（Azure Sentinel 参与者）
Azure Sentinel Responder（Azure Sentinel 响应者）

questions.explanation_zh: 需求是 admin1 能配置 Playbook，同时遵循最小权限。Sentinel Contributor 可创建和编辑分析规则及基于 Logic Apps 的 Playbook；自动化操作员只能运行已有 Playbook，自动化 Runbook 操作员只能运行 Automation 账户中的 Runbook，Responder 仅能处理事件与警报，三者都无法新建或修改 Playbook。

Introductory Info

Case study -
This is a case study. Case studies are not timed separately. You can use as much exam time as you would like to
complete each case. However, there may be additional case studies and sections on this exam. You must manage your
time to ensure that you are able to complete all questions included on this exam in the time provided.
To answer the questions included in a case study, you will need to reference information that is provided in the case
study. Case studies might contain exhibits and other resources that provide more information about the scenario that is
described in the case study. Each question is independent of the other questions in this case study.
At the end of this case study, a review screen will appear. This screen allows you to review your answers and to make
changes before you move to the next section of the exam. After you begin a new section, you cannot return to this
section.

To start the case study -
To display the first question in this case study, click the Next button. Use the buttons in the left pane to explore the
content of the case study before you answer the questions. Clicking these buttons displays information such as business
requirements, existing environment, and problem statements. If the case study has an All Information tab, note that the
information displayed is identical to the information displayed on the subsequent tabs. When you are ready to answer a
question, click the Question button to return to the question.

Overview -
Litware Inc. is a renewable energy company.
Litware has offices in Boston and Seattle. Litware also has remote users located across the United States. To access
Litware resources, including cloud resources, the remote users establish a VPN connection to either office.

Existing Environment -

Identity Environment -
The network contains an Active Directory forest named litware.com that syncs to an Azure Active Directory (Azure AD)
tenant named litware.com.

ent -
Microsoft 365 Environment -
Litware has a Microsoft 365 E5 subscription linked to the litware.com Azure AD tenant. Microsoft Defender for Endpoint
is deployed to all computers that run Windows 10. All Microsoft Cloud App Security built-in anomaly detection policies
are enabled.

Azure Environment -
Litware has an Azure subscription linked to the litware.com Azure AD tenant. The subscription contains resources in the
East US Azure region as shown in the following table.








Network Environment -
Each Litware office connects directly to the internet and has a site-to-site VPN connection to the virtual networks in the
Azure subscription.

On-premises Environment -
The on-premises network contains the computers shown in the following table.







Current problems -
Cloud App Security frequently generates false positive alerts when users connect to both offices simultaneously.

Planned Changes and Requirements
Planned Changes -
Litware plans to implement the following changes:
Create and configure Azure Sentinel in the Azure subscription.
Validate Azure Sentinel functionality by using Azure AD test user accounts.

Business Requirements -
Litware identifies the following business requirements:
The principle of least privilege must be used whenever possible.
Costs must be minimized, as long as all other requirements are met.
Logs collected by Log Analytics must provide a full audit trail of user activities.
All domain controllers must be protected by using Microsoft Defender for Identity.

Azure Information Protection Requirements
All files that have security labels and are stored on the Windows 10 computers must be available from the Azure
Information Protection " Data discovery dashboard.

Microsoft Defender for Endpoint requirements
All Cloud App Security unsanctioned apps must be blocked on the Windows 10 computers by using Microsoft Defender
for Endpoint.

Microsoft Cloud App Security requirements
tidentify  whether   a  user  connection    is anomalous      based   on  tenant-level   data.
Azure Defender Requirements -
All servers must send logs to the same Log Analytics workspace.

Azure Sentinel Requirements -
Litware must meet the following Azure Sentinel requirements:
Integrate Azure Sentinel and Cloud App Security.
Ensure that a user named admin1 can configure Azure Sentinel playbooks.
Create an Azure Sentinel analytics rule based on a custom query. The rule must automatically initiate the execution of a
playbook.
Add notes to events that represent data access from a specific IP address to provide the ability to reference the IP
address when navigating through an investigation graph while hunting.
Create a test rule that generates alerts when inbound access to Microsoft Office 365 by the Azure AD test user accounts
is detected. Alerts generated by the rule must be grouped into individual incidents, with one incident per test user
account.
